evidence: Touches src/node/txorphanage.{cpp,h} to resolve an assertion abort in orphan eviction resource accounting, carrying the P2P label.
rationale: Prevents an assertion abort in TxOrphanage caused by integer division yielding zero when peer count exceeds 3,000. As noted in the description, integer division gives each peer an allowance of zero when orphan announcements exceed the global threshold, causing LimitOrphans() to crash the node; while serious, this requires non-default configuration well above the standard connection limit.
